examples.title: Match-move an element with animated transform values
examples.code:
# Transform knobs can be animated or expression-linked to tracking data.
transform = nuke.createNode("Transform")
transform.setInput(0, element)
transform["translate"].setValue(100, 0)
transform["translate"].setValue(50, 1)
